about: Test vectors for the X-Caddie-Admin v1 request signature (scripts/lib/admin-sign.mjs). The Worker verifier (worker/src/lib/admin-auth.js) and the CLI are tested against this one file. Three kinds of case: "sign" (signer input and the exact header it must produce), "verify" (what the verifier answers for a header, given the keys it holds and its clock) and "reject" (input the signer refuses before anything is sent). All times are Unix seconds; `now` is Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000). Keys are UTF-8 after trimming, never hex-decoded. The signed path is new URL(path, base).pathname + search, where base is an origin (no path, query or fragment): the path must match path_re (one leading "/", segments of letters, digits, "_", "." and "-", no empty segment so no "//" anywhere, no backslash, nothing that would be percent-encoded) and the query must match query_re (the comma is allowed for lists such as fields=text,contact), so both sides see the same bytes without any escaping rule; free text travels base64url-encoded under a key ending in 64. ts has no leading zero (header_re), so a raw-string verifier and Number() agree.

verify_reasons._note: The reference verifier checks in this order: malformed, bodyless_body_hash, no_key, signature, skew, and reports the first that applies. A verifier may check no_key before malformed (the Worker does). When several reasons apply, any one of those applying reasons is acceptable; all map to 404, except skew, which is 401 admin_skew and can only follow a valid signature.
verify_reasons.malformed: the header is absent or does not match header_re (Worker: 404)
verify_reasons.bodyless_body_hash: GET, HEAD or DELETE with a bodySha256 other than empty_body_sha256 (Worker: 404)
verify_reasons.no_key: the Worker holds no usable key: ADMIN_TOKEN missing or shorter than 32 after trimming (Worker: 404)
verify_reasons.signature: no held key reproduces sig (Worker: take() the failed-auth bucket, 404)
verify_reasons.skew: |now - ts| > skew_seconds, checked only after the signature matched (Worker: 401 admin_skew)

reject_reasons._note: Each reject case names the UsageError.code the signer throws. These are all the codes the signer has.
reject_reasons.path_charset: the path does not match path_re (an empty segment, a backslash, a character that would be percent-encoded, or not absolute), or resolves to another origin than base
reject_reasons.query_charset: the query string after "?" does not match query_re
reject_reasons.body_on_bodyless_method: a body on GET, HEAD or DELETE
reject_reasons.key_too_short: the key is missing or shorter than min_key_length after trimming
reject_reasons.body_type: the body is neither a string nor bytes
reject_reasons.nonce: a nonce given to the signer (tests only) is not 22 base64url characters
reject_reasons.ts: the signing time is negative or longer than 12 digits
reject_reasons.url: the base is not a URL, or is not an origin (it has a path, query or fragment)

cases.title: GET without a body: the empty-body hash
POST with a JSON body
GET with since=<ISO instant>: ":" and "-" pass the query charset
GET with q64=<base64url of "Ann Lee">: free text never travels raw
cases.note: q64 is base64url without padding of the UTF-8 search text "Ann Lee"; the signer would refuse q=Ann%20Lee (see reject-query-percent).

cases.title: POST with a non-ASCII body: the hash covers the UTF-8 bytes
POST with a 4-byte body
DELETE without a body: the empty-body hash
HEAD without a body: the empty-body hash
PUT with a JSON body on the DirectoryDO path
The body of post-moderation with one byte changed: a different hash and signature
cases.note: Compare with post-moderation: same key, method, path, ts and nonce; only the last byte of the body differs.

cases.title: POST signed with the second key (ADMIN_TOKEN_NEXT during a rotation)
The key with surrounding whitespace signs exactly as key1: both sides trim
cases.note: Same ts and nonce as get-stats, so the header must be identical.

cases.title: PUT /admin/conferences with allow_shrink in the body: flags travel in the body, so the hash and the signature change
cases.note: Compare with put-conferences: same key, method, path, ts and nonce; the body gained "allow_shrink": true, and body_sha256 and sig differ. A flag in the query would be outside the body hash and must not be used.

cases.title: GET with no query string at all
A query using every allowed character class
A one-digit timestamp (the header allows 1 to 12 digits)
PUT /admin/conferences with "unretire": true on the document (conferences unretire on tier 2): a body flag, never a query key
A path ending in "?" with no query: the canonical path has no "?"
cases.note: new URL gives an empty search, so path_with_query is "/admin/stats", the same as get-no-query.

cases.title: GET /admin/people/view with fields=text,contact: the comma is in the query charset for lists
A positive case verifies with key1
The second key is accepted when the Worker holds both (rotation overlap)
A header signed with key2 verifies when only key2 is held (after the rotation)
A header signed with key2 fails when only key1 is held: signature
A wrong key: signature
The Worker trims its secret: a padded key1 verifies key1 headers
A changed path: signature
A changed method: signature
The one-byte-different body hash under the original signature: signature
A changed timestamp: signature
A changed nonce: signature
A GET whose header carries a non-empty body hash: refused before any HMAC
A DELETE whose header carries a non-empty body hash: refused before any HMAC
now = ts + 300: inside the window
now = ts + 301: skew
now = ts - 300 (a client clock ahead): inside the window
now = ts - 301: skew
A wrong key with a stale timestamp fails on the signature, never on the skew: a non-holder sees only 404
No usable key (missing or shorter than 32 after trimming): no_key
No header: malformed
An empty header: malformed
Version v2: malformed
The old bearer form: malformed
A 21-character nonce: malformed
A nonce with base64 padding: malformed
A 63-character signature: malformed
An uppercase hex signature: malformed (hex is lowercase)
Two spaces between fields: malformed
A trailing newline: malformed
A leading space: malformed
A 13-digit timestamp (milliseconds by mistake): malformed
A negative timestamp: malformed
A fifth field: malformed
A timestamp with a leading zero: malformed (a raw-string verifier and Number() must agree)
The header value sent twice and joined by the HTTP layer ("<h>, <h>"): malformed
An uppercase hex body hash: malformed (hex is lowercase)
q=a%20b: "%" is outside the query charset
cases.note: Free text goes under q64, base64url-encoded (see get-q64).

cases.title: q=a b: a space (which new URL would encode as %20) is outside the charset
q=a+b: "+" is outside the charset
A "/" in the query is outside the charset
Non-ASCII in the query is outside the charset
A GET with a body
A DELETE with a body
A key shorter than 32 characters
A key that is whitespace only
No key
An unserialised object as the body
cases.note: The caller serialises, so the hash covers the exact bytes sent.

cases.title: No method
Non-ASCII in the path (it would be percent-encoded)
A space in the path (it would be percent-encoded)
An empty segment inside the path ("/admin//stats")
A path starting with "//" (it would name another host)
A backslash in the path (the URL parser would turn it into a slash)
A path without a leading "/"
A full URL instead of a path
A percent-encoded path
A nonce that is not 22 base64url characters (tests only; the signer draws its own)
A signing time out of range (tests only)
cases.note: The signer takes now in milliseconds, as Date.now() gives it, and floors it to seconds for ts; -1000 ms is ts -1. Every other time in this file is seconds.

cases.title: A base that is not a URL
A base with a path: the base is an origin, because new URL(path, base) would drop that path
